description: Twin-engined light aircraft in white with red trim and Peruvian roundels mounted on a pylon in the Parque del Avión, Mollepata, Ayacucho, known locally as the Parque de la Avioneta or 'narcoavioneta' (a 2021 local video recounts it as a seized drug-running aircraft handed to the town). Type and registration not established from available imagery; needs an on-site identification.
